proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: A thickening induces a homeomorphism on each fibre with equal residue fields, so pushforward bijects the families of r-cycles on the fibres; and a family is a relative cycle exactly when its pushforward is, by the check-after-closed lemma; combining the bijection with the equivalence gives the bijection on relative cycles (source lines 1469-1477)

standard_prerequisites.use: Gives alpha in z(X/S, r) if and only if i_* alpha in z(X'/S, r).

core_obligations: Show i_* : z(X/S, r) -> z(X'/S, r) is a bijection (proof lines 1469-1477). On each fibre i_s is a thickening, a homeomorphism inducing isomorphisms on residue fields, so i_* induces a bijection between the families of r-cycles on the fibres of X/S and of X'/S (proof lines 1470-1473). For a family alpha of r-cycles on the fibres of X/S, alpha in z(X/S, r) if and only if i_* alpha in z(X'/S, r) by lemma-check-after-closed (tag 0H54) (proof lines 1474-1476); combining, i_* is a bijection on the subsets z(X/S, r) and z(X'/S, r) (proof line 1476).
proof_roadmap: Fibre-wise bijection on families of r-cycles from the thickening (proof lines 1470-1473).
Equivalence of the relative cycle condition under i_* from the check-after-closed lemma (proof lines 1474-1476).
Combine to conclude the bijection (proof line 1476).
